input.document_text: Warranty Claim Form. Product: Sony Bravia 55-inch 4K LED TV (Model KD-55X80L). Serial Number: SY-TV-4521-B. Customer: Mohan Das. Purchase Date: 2025-09-01. Warranty Duration: 2 years from purchase. Warranty Expiry: 2027-09-01. Coverage: Panel defects, backlight issues, internal component failure.
